text_block_list.text:
в тренировке, Грасс Вандер seems to
be
suffering from the heat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yes... I can manage. Just give me a
moment to
cool off, and I should be
back on my feet in no
time.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to have forced this pause on
our training
session.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I wish my body would adapt to summer
better.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Not a fan of the heat?

text_block_list.text:
I suppose not. Cold weather doesn't
bother me,
but sweltering heat like this
is a different matter...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
If only there were a good way to
overcome it...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: If you clear your mind, even fire will feel cool!
There are traditional ways to beat the heat!

text_block_list.text: That's... a Japanese saying, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
If I cool my thoughts, the heat can't
bother me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I see. This type of mentality might be
what I need
right now.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Let's see whose focus can outlast the other's!

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is that a challenge? You know I
can't back
down from that, right? ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Very well, Trainer. I accept, and I won't
lose. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That's true. Off the top of my head,
there are
hand fans, wind chimes,
watermelons... Or
perhaps a splash of
water.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Eheh—you know, I feel cooler already
just saying
those words. So... which do
you think we should
try, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
However... so am I. ♪ Let's make
preparations at
once.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A quest to beat the heat together...
Hehe, I can
hardly wait. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Today's session was a bit rough on her,
but it
seems like Грасс Вандер has
gotten the hang of
dealing with hot
weather.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today's session was a bit rough on her,
but it
seems like Грасс Вандер has
learned how to
enjoy hot weather.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
